findings.claim: decision.json silently emits null executive_summary/investment_thesis when the PM decision uses the zh-TW free-text labels (執行摘要 / 投資論述).
findings.evidence: kuroshio/cli.py _write_decision_json called the vendored _extract_markdown_field with the English label only; the vendored writer tries both locales for stop/target.
findings.repro: a 5_portfolio/decision.md with '**執行摘要**: ...' -> executive_summary null
findings.acceptance: the prose fields carry the section text for zh-TW decisions too; when neither label is present the null is stated on stderr
findings.resolution: cli.py tries the English then the zh-TW label (labels match engine/config/i18n/zh-TW.yaml); two new tests; stderr line only when both labels miss

notes: no single test asserts ledger row == sidecar; verified by hand (Buy/90.5/130.25 agree, stop 0 survives)
_write_decision_json is not wrapped like the ledger append; a write error would abort after the tree is saved (not reproduced)
probe: propose on the desk's 17-name file, scratch ledger, 10.9 s
